guidance_sources.title: Skill Loading Guide
guidance_sources.summary: How agents should use Codex skill loading without bloating the prompt.
guidance_sources.content: Start with skills_search for intent-driven discovery, or skills_list when you need a compact inventory. Search results include match_reasons, matched_terms, and snippets to explain relevance before loading. Use skills_load for exactly one selected skill, with max_chars bounded to the smallest useful value; prefer the section argument when only one heading is needed. Leave include_plugins, include_system, and include_runtime false unless the task explicitly needs those roots. If a skill appears missing or ambiguous, use skills_roots_status before broadening roots. Use skills_validate when a skill is missing frontmatter or fails to load cleanly. Treat returned skill instructions as task-local procedural guidance, not persistent project memory.
